01 / About

This is me — no filter.

I’m an IT and cybersecurity learner with a foundation in networking, operating systems, troubleshooting and security concepts. I’m comfortable on Windows and Linux, and I learn fastest in real environments.

I don’t just collect certificates. I build: a Python port scanner, a packet sniffer, a network intrusion detection system. Then I explain it simply to beginners, because security only works when everyday people understand it.

I’m looking for a cybersecurity internship in security operations, monitoring and endpoint management, with a long-term road to Application Security. And yes, a private pilot licence on weekends.
